links.outcome: Reader diagnostic accuracy and interpretation time with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: AI assistance improved overall diagnostic accuracy from 0.870 to 0.940 (p < 0.001) and reduced interpretation time from 22.70 to 9.58 s (p < 0.001).
links.quote: AI assistance improved overall diagnostic accuracy from 0.870 to 0.940 (p < 0.001) and reduced interpretation time from 22.70 to 9.58 s (p < 0.001).

links.quote: AI assistance improved overall diagnostic accuracy from 0.870 to 0.940 (p < 0.001) and reduced interpretation time from 22.70 to 9.58 s (p < 0.001).
